description: This file defines an abstract controller class for administrative modules in the Goteo project. It sets up theme, routing, permissions, and other common functionalities shared by concrete admin controllers.

classes.name: AbstractAdminController
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionalities for admin controllers, including theme setup, routing, permission checks, and default index action.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns an identifier for the controller, derived from the class name by removing 'AdminController' suffix and lowercasing.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns a label for the controller, optionally as icon, text, or HTML, based on class static properties.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the default sidebar group this controller belongs to; defaults to 'activity'.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Provides the default route mapping to the indexAction of the controller, under the module's base URL.

methods.name: getSidebar
methods.description: Returns an array of sidebar links specific to this controller; empty by default.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to access this controller, based on permissions like 'admin-any-module' or 'admin-module-[id]'.

methods.name: indexAction
methods.description: Default action that displays an error message indicating no routes are defined; meant to be overridden.
